steps.en: Point it at a Markdown file, or at - to read from a pipe
steps.zh: 把一个 Markdown 文件交给它，或传 - 从管道读入

steps.en: Parses the text with Python-Markdown into a tree of headings, lists, tables and code blocks
steps.zh: 用 Python-Markdown 把文本解析成一棵树：标题、列表、表格、代码块

steps.en: Colors each element from a theme, highlights code with Pygments, fits tables to the terminal width
steps.zh: 按主题给每个元素上色，用 Pygments 高亮代码，按终端宽度排表格

steps.en: Prints the styled document straight into the terminal
steps.zh: 把排好样式的文档直接打印到终端里

value.en: A README reads like a formatted document over SSH, with no browser or GUI app in the loop
value.zh: 通过 SSH 也能像看排版好的文档一样读 README，全程不用浏览器或图形界面应用

sources: https://github.com/axiros/terminal_markdown_viewer#cli (mdv [OPTIONS] MDFILE; -t THEME; stty for terminal size, 80 cols when piped)
https://github.com/axiros/terminal_markdown_viewer/blob/master/mdv/markdownviewer.py (read_md: filename '-' reads sys.stdin; markdown Treeprocessor AnsiPrinter; vendored tabulate; pygments)
https://github.com/axiros/terminal_markdown_viewer/blob/master/setup.py (version 1.7.5; install_requires pygments, markdown; extras yaml; console_scripts mdv)
